payout_quote: Official superprof.com/tutor: 'It's up to you to set your rates. The rate that is shown in your ad is the rate that you have chosen, and what you will receive. We don't take any commission!' And: 'At Superprof, it is free to create your teaching ad and to start sharing your passion!'
steps: Create a free Superprof teaching ad for your subject/skill.
Set your own hourly rate (what you display is what you receive).
Students contact you directly through Superprof; arrange lessons.
Get paid directly at your posted rate — Superprof takes no commission.
catches: Superprof is a lead/advertising platform — students pay you directly, so you handle collection and scheduling yourself.
Earnings are fully variable: you set the rate, but there is no guaranteed volume of students.
Free to publish ads; no commission on lessons.
You are an independent tutor; taxes, travel, and materials are your own cost.
biggest_catch: Superprof takes zero commission but also provides no payment processing or guaranteed students — it's an ad listing, so your earnings depend entirely on attracting students and collecting payment yourself.
eligibility: Expertise in the subject you teach; 18+.
timing: Paid directly by students per lesson; no platform payout schedule.
